name: console-get-logs
description: Recent Unity Console entries. levels filters severity (default Error, Exception, Assert, Warning); contains searches message text. Counts: matched=pre-dedupe hits, groups=after dedupe, count=returned, dropped=omitted, repeats=duplicates per row.

contains.description: Message substring (case-insensitive). A bare error/warning/exception/issue token filters severity instead — use levels for that.

sinceEventId.description: Only logs after this event cursor; capture lastEventId before a compile/reimport. Bridge-captured logs only.

sinceTimestampUtc.description: Only logs at/after this UTC ISO time. Prefer sinceEventId.

dedupe.description: Collapse duplicates into one row with repeats. Default on.
